optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Reliability Statistician, Industrial Pump Fleet Analytics

professionalSummary.text: Reliability statistician with three years and seven months of experience building survival and degradation models for industrial pump maintenance intervals, including monthly review of field failure data with service engineers under documented procedures and documentation of model limitations for contract customers.
professionalSummary.witness: Reliability analyst on the pump fleet analytics team of a pump service company for three years and seven months, building the survival and degradation models behind the maintenance intervals for two pump families. Reviewed the field failure data with the service engineers each month under the team's data quality procedure, keeping the exclusion log for mislabelled failures. Wrote the model limitation notes and the interval boundary statements sent to contract customers with each interval recommendation, and presented the recommendations to two contract customers with the head of fleet analytics.

experienceHighlights.text: Built survival and degradation models for two pump families' maintenance intervals over three years and seven months at a pump service company, directly supporting the reliability modeling requirement.
experienceHighlights.witness: Reliability analyst on the pump fleet analytics team of a pump service company for three years and seven months, building the survival and degradation models behind the maintenance intervals for two pump families.

experienceHighlights.text: Reviewed field failure data with service engineers monthly under a documented data quality procedure, maintaining an exclusion log for mislabelled failures.
experienceHighlights.witness: Reviewed the field failure data with the service engineers each month under the team's data quality procedure, keeping the exclusion log for mislabelled failures.

experienceHighlights.text: Documented model limitations and interval boundaries for contract customers, presenting recommendations to two customers with the head of fleet analytics.
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote the model limitation notes and the interval boundary statements sent to contract customers with each interval recommendation, and presented the recommendations to two contract customers with the head of fleet analytics.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Survival model workbook and interval recommendation note for one pump family, including data platform query references as verification trail.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: the survival model workbook and the interval recommendation note for one pump family, with the data platform query references as a verification trail, and the transcript of the two completed postgraduate modules.

skills.text: Applied statistics (postgraduate modules completed in 2023-2024, two of eight modules for a master's degree)
skills.witness: Education: BEng, Mechanical Engineering, 2018; postgraduate modules in applied statistics at a distance-learning university, two of eight modules completed in 2023 and 2024, no award. Work sample: the survival model workbook and the interval recommendation note for one pump family, with the data platform query references as a verification trail, and the transcript of the two completed postgraduate modules.
